Points of sale
Online ticket office
Buy your ticket online and board the train with an SMS!
The online ticket office lets you:
Buy your ticket for the Alfa Pendular, Intercidades, Regional, InterRegional, Coimbra Urban trains and Porto urban train journeys;
Add the passengers accompanying you on your journeys;
Choose your seat;
Get a refund, change your tickets or the passenger names for tickets bought online (simply access the journey details in the ‘
My trips
’ area on cp.pt).
You can buy your ticket up to 60 days in advance and until 15 minutes before the train leaves your station.
You can pay by:
PayPal (using your account or paying with your card, no pre-registration required);
Credit card;
Debit card that can also be used with credit card functionality;
Visa or MasterCard, i.e. with a security code on the back of the card;
MB WAY.
For more information see the
Online Ticket Office Terms and Conditions
.
Note:
Buy your CP tickets safely. Always use the official CP channels. Websites like Rail.Ninja, Kiwi, Firebirdtours or Destiny Travel Brasil are not official partners of CP and may charge higher prices. Furthet details:
Unauthorised sale of CP tickets
Buy now
